mapper.select: SELECT FROM fulfillment_merchant_jobs WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND operation=#{operation} AND expected_version=#{expectedVersion} AND NOT (operation='CONFIRM' AND step='ORDER' AND status='REJECTED' AND COALESCE(last_error,'')='ORDER_MUTATION_REJECTED')
SELECT FROM fulfillment_merchant_jobs WHERE command_id=#{commandId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM fulfillment_merchant_jobs WHERE status='REVIEW_REQUIRED' ORDER BY updated_at,command_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM fulfillment_merchant_recoveries WHERE command_id=#{commandId} AND recovery_id=#{recoveryId}
SELECT FROM fulfillment_merchant_recoveries WHERE command_id=#{commandId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE fulfillment_merchant_jobs SET status='PENDING',attempts=0, next_attempt_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE command_id=#{commandId} AND status='REVIEW_REQUIRED' AND owner_token IS NULL AND lease_until IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT command_id FROM fulfillment_merchant_jobs WHERE status='PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) ORDER BY next_attempt_at,command_id LIMIT 10
mapper.update: UPDATE fulfillment_merchant_jobs SET owner_token=#{owner},lease_until=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,60,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)), attempts=attempts+1,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE command_id=#{commandId} AND status='PENDING' AND (#{immediate} OR next_attempt_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6))

UPDATE fulfillment_merchant_jobs SET step='ORDER',attempts=1,last_error=NULL, lease_until=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,60,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE command_id=#{commandId} AND owner_token=#{owner} AND lease_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)

UPDATE fulfillment_merchant_jobs SET status=#{status},last_error=#{error},owner_token=NULL, lease_until=NULL,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE command_id=#{commandId} AND owner_token=#{owner} AND lease_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)

UPDATE fulfillment_merchant_jobs SET status=CASE WHEN attempts >= 6 THEN 'REVIEW_REQUIRED' ELSE 'PENDING' END, last_error=#{error},owner_token=NULL,lease_until=NULL, next_attempt_at=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,LEAST(POWER(2,attempts),30),CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)), updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE command_id=#{commandId} AND owner_token=#{owner} AND lease_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
